findings.description: The department reported retirement in April 2026 and continuing research with colleagues; exact date and emeritus title not established. Generic faculty roster conflicts with the specific retirement announcement.
Listed in emeritus section despite profile title professor; Pittsburgh reports his 2017 move from UF and later Pittsburgh professorship, leaving no supported current UF professorial appointment.

Zoleikha Biron is absent from the current primary roster; an older UF institute profile lists her, but Clemson lists her as assistant professor with a Fall 2026 office. No current official UF ECE affiliation established; investigate if new evidence indicates a retained appointment.

Searched official department news and broader university sources for incoming and affiliate omissions; no confirmed incoming professor discovered. This search cannot guarantee announcements are exhaustive.
